description: This PHP class defines the DataGroupPermission entity, which maps to the ohrm_user_role_data_group table in the database. It encapsulates permissions related to data groups, including read, create, update, delete, and self permissions, linked to user roles and data groups. It includes getter and setter methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Represents permissions for user roles regarding data groups, including CRUD permissions and self-permission, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_user_role_data_group'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether the read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether the create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether the update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether the delete permission is granted.

methods.name: setDataGroup
methods.description: Associates a DataGroup entity with this permission.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this permission.
